## Overview

Wire DeepSeek-V4's supported MoE/DeepEP low-latency path for batch-invariant execution. Stable expert selection, token-local quantization, rank-synchronous dispatch capacity, and graph-safe metadata are separate parts of the contract; unsupported kernels fail closed.

- Use the supported DeepGEMM expert backend and stable router GEMM. Align masked/contiguous SiLU x Mul FP8 scales, routed-expert clamp, and accumulation.
- Stage DeepEP LL dispatch at `VLLM_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK` (default **128**). The rank-wide token maximum sets the stage count, so empty tail stages still join collectives. Shared experts run once for the full local batch.
- Avoid live GPU-to-host expert maxima during graph capture; choose the shared-expert auxiliary stream on MNNVL only when its preconditions hold.

## Architecture

![DeepSeek-V4 MoE and rank-synchronous DeepEP staging](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/inaniloquentee/d5a1e05c74fddb335aa38a58bf30fb4f/raw/7970e2de8109265c8b1c62eeb723f57e76cf7b1c/ds4-p3-deepep-moe-architecture.svg)

## Test

The stable `_C` extension rebuilt on an **unpublished** current-`main` merge candidate on H20. Targeted sparse-index, top-k, paged/contiguous logits, and MoE dispatch checks: **16 passed, 2 skipped**. The two skips require a DeepGEMM build with batch-invariant masked-grouped controls absent from the currently pinned package. These are not CI results on the current PR head. Multi-rank DeepEP staging and full-model evaluation remain unrun; this PR does not claim train/rollout equivalence.

### Perf

The shared-expert stream commit reported **17,036 -> 18,150 tok/s (+6.5%)** on DS4-Flash/GB200. It was not rerun for this PR, and the report lacks GPU count, workload, and variance. This is not an end-to-end gain for the whole MoE path.

## Overview

Wire DeepSeek-V4's supported MoE/DeepEP low-latency path for batch-invariant execution. Stable expert selection, token-local quantization, rank-synchronous dispatch capacity, and graph-safe metadata are separate parts of the contract; unsupported kernels fail closed.

- Use the supported DeepGEMM expert backend and stable router GEMM. Align masked/contiguous SiLU x Mul FP8 scales, routed-expert clamp, and accumulation.
- Stage DeepEP LL dispatch at `VLLM_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK` (default **128**). The rank-wide token maximum sets the stage count, so empty tail stages still join collectives. Shared experts run once for the full local batch.
- Avoid live GPU-to-host expert maxima during graph capture; choose the shared-expert auxiliary stream on MNNVL only when its preconditions hold.

## Architecture

![DeepSeek-V4 MoE and rank-synchronous DeepEP staging](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/inaniloquentee/d5a1e05c74fddb335aa38a58bf30fb4f/raw/7970e2de8109265c8b1c62eeb723f57e76cf7b1c/ds4-p3-deepep-moe-architecture.svg)

## Test

The stable `_C` extension rebuilt on an **unpublished** current-`main` merge candidate on H20. Targeted sparse-index, top-k, paged/contiguous logits, and MoE dispatch checks: **16 passed, 2 skipped**. The two skips require a DeepGEMM build with batch-invariant masked-grouped controls absent from the currently pinned package. These are not CI results on the current PR head. Multi-rank DeepEP staging and full-model evaluation remain unrun; this PR does not claim train/rollout equivalence.

### Perf

The shared-expert stream commit reported **17,036 -> 18,150 tok/s (+6.5%)** on DS4-Flash/GB200. It was not rerun for this PR, and the report lacks GPU count, workload, and variance. This is not an end-to-end gain for the whole MoE path.
